This document 
outlines the testing procedure for start up Control System for the gas turbine 
at the locations: Talkha GT, Hurgada, Sharm Al-Shaikh, and Port Said GT Power Stations.

Components : SSKC, SGDD, VCE METER, Start up 
 indicating light.

The first draft initiated by eng. Wagdy Eid 
Mansour and tested by eng. Magdy Saad El Khamesy, at date 2/6/2003 ,reviewed by eng. Abd 
El-Monem El-Emam at EDEPC, accepted by general director eng. Yousry Ahmed Abd El-Maksoud 
and approved by eng. Mostafa Abdel Hameed Allam: Head Sector of Talkha Power 
Station.

This document was updated at Port Said by adding 
Characteristics "C/CS" curve to the document at 20Nov 2004.

The first draft is updated by eng. Wagdy Eid 
Mansour , tested by eng. Eman El Bastawesy at date 11/2/2009 ,Reviewed by EDEPC 
quality control eng. Adel Elnagar , Accepted by general director eng. Mamdouh 
El-saeid Anber ,and approved by eng.Farouk awad head sector of Talkha Power 
Plant .

sections.text:
Jumper " NOTLCDA-4 " (SW6R34) to acom (GOIR 02) to put "0" on pin 30 of SSKC 
 and remove VCE clamp

Jumper to drop out the " Firing " SLEH element and put "0" on pin 28 of SSKC 
 check value is " fire " VCE

Jumper to pick up the " 28 FDX " SLEH element and put "0" on pin 18 of SSKC 
 after 2 SEC check value is " Warm-up " VCE

Jumper to pick up the "2WX" SLEH element and put "0" on pin 6 of SSKC check 
 that VCE accelerates on a one minute time constant

Rotate " MAN VCE " knob through its range verify that " speed control abnormal 
 " light energizes with a slight clockwise movement from off. Return knob to 
 off.

Remove jumper to drop out the firing SLEH element and check that VCE goes to 
 zero.
Remove all jumpers and test equipment.
